text:
anna-partnerships: Looping in security + legal. KeyLattice wants to go live in our cloud marketplace (EU + US) and do a co-announcement. They need SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, and a KMS BYOK/HSM connector for Dedicated. Need a short checklist + owners and embargo timing. Can we sync tomorrow 10am PT? cc kai-security, jenna-legal, mike-ecosystem

kai-security: Quick questions up front — will KeyLattice host keys in their HSM or request BYOK into our KMS? Do they have HSM attestation docs? We need SOC2 + HSM certs before integration.

mike-ecosystem: Marketplace ops notes: EU marketplace requires GDPR residency text. We also need partner logo (SVG), one-line description, 3 screenshots (16:9), and SKU mapping for Hosted vs Dedicated. Does KeyLattice support partner billing?

alice-solutions: Started a SCIM PoC with their devs. They map to `employeeId` instead of `externalId` which is fine. SCIM mapping draft: ```scim: { userName -> emails[0], externalId -> employeeId, name.givenName -> firstName, name.familyName -> lastName }``` Groups sync: they want group -> role mapping; need to confirm group size limits.

jenna-legal: Partner asked for announcement week of Apr 25 and co-marketing. We'll need an NDA addendum for joint PR + logo usage. Also flag: HSM/key export might trigger export-control review. I can draft NDA amendment if we lock dates.

sam-sales: Heads-up: KeyLattice has a partner event Apr 28 and prefers press on Apr 27 before demo. Sales needs a pricing commitment for Dedicated (min QPS/commit) before we finalize marketplace SKU.

kai-security: Action items I can take: vendor security questionnaire (VSA), request HSM attestation, and a key lifecycle/rotation plan. Also need the KMS integration diagram and a basic threat model. ETA for VSA: Wed 4/3.

anna-partnerships: Owners so far: kai -> VSA + threat model + HSM checks; alice -> SCIM mapping + SAML flows + API contract; mike -> marketplace assets/listing + regional copy; jenna -> legal/NDA + embargo; sam -> PR timing/co-sell commitments. Meeting tomorrow 10am PT — Zoom (I'll send invite). If you can't make it, drop notes here.

deploy-bot: reminder: meeting scheduled for 2026-04-03 10:00 PT — Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood.com/meet/1234 :calendar:

alice-solutions: One more technical note — KMS plan should support hybrid: partner-managed HSM + Redwood KMS with imported keys. Will draft the API contract and a fallback for Dedicated routing.

kai-security: Also confirm SCIM deprovision behavior (2xx vs 404), SAML assertion audience/replay controls, and audit log retention windows for key ops.

anna-partnerships: I'll post pre-reads: VSA template, SCIM attribute mapping doc, and marketplace asset checklist. Thanks all :rocket:
